jobs.title: Stage - Ingénieur.e SQA Python, banc de test physique - H/F
jobs.description: Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé. Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé. Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main. En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront : - Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app. - Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures) - Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation) - Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED). - Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique. - Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet. - Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer. - Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code. Requirements Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ; Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ; Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impres

jobs.title: Interim QA Specialist
jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete. What you'll do Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests What we are looking for 5+ years in QA on web applications At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar) You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing Nice to haves Experience with complex B2B SaaS Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests API testing (REST, Postman or similar) Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP) Mobile app testing (iOS / Android) What you’ll get Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance A results-based bonus

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. Role Overview As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions. Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production. You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners. What You'll Do Hardware Testing & Automation Develop and execute test plans and procedures for electronic boards, assemblies, and sub-systems. Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing. Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance. Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis. Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility. Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs. Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production. Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management. Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions. Investigate hardware failures and collaborate with design engineers on corrective actions. Contribute to design-for-test and design-for-manufacturing improvements. Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams. Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and product

jobs.description: About Sonio Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents. Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path. Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence. Your responsibilities Own the QMS: maintain it, update procedures, and manage nonconformities and complaints, with a strong appetite for automation (Notion, HubSpot, n8n, Claude). Lead all the audit phases: preparation, run, and follow-up Train and upskill the company on quality: onboard all new hires on QA practices and processes, run regular training and refreshers for existing teams, and keep training material up to date as processes evolve. Contribute to the ISMS alongside the security team: align QMS and ISMS processes (document control, CAPA, internal audits) and support HITRUST / SOC 2 audit readiness. We expect this person to build a shared quality culture, not only by building processes, but also by ensuring they support the team's work and have a real impact on end-user quality delivery. About the profile Sonio is a mission-driven company, so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are: 5 years of QMS management experience in software as a medical device. You bring strong knowledge of the MDR (Medical Device Regulation, Europe) and the QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation, USA). You have experience leading audits. Experience in post-market surveillance (PMS) and vigilance processes. Proven experience automating tools and processes You have experience building a quality culture with good English communication that allows you to get people on board with what you're building Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, or HITRUST is a plus. Location : Paris Salary : 60-65K + 10% We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month.
